title: sec: RootCandidate default signature_valid=true is fail-open
description: In multi_instance.rs line 710, RootCandidate::new() defaults signature_valid to true. This fail-open design means forgotten or failed verification passes untrusted candidates through the filter at line 829. Change default to false; require explicit .with_signature_valid(true) only after verification.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed RootCandidate::new() default signature_valid from true to false (fail-closed). Updated all tests to explicitly call .with_signature_valid(true) after verification.
